history.content: which of these is best description of passive transport

Based on the document provided, passive transport is described as the net movement of material from an area of high concentration to an area with lower concentration. This process is driven by the concentration gradient, where the difference in concentration between the two areas is termed as the concentration gradient. Diffusion continues until this gradient has been eliminated. However, in some cases, the driving force of passive transport cannot be simplified to the concentration gradient. For instance, if there are different solutions at the two sides of the membrane with different equilibrium solubility of the drug, the difference in degree of saturation becomes the driving force of passive membrane transport. This is also true for supersaturated solutions, which are becoming increasingly important due to the use of amorphous solid dispersions for drug bioavailability enhancement.

Yes, Active Transport is a process where molecules are moved across a membrane from a region of their lower concentration to a region of their higher concentration, against the concentration gradient or other obstructing factors. This process requires energy, often in the form of ATP, and is facilitated by specialized transmembrane proteins. There are two forms of active transport: primary active transport and secondary active transport.

Semi-permeability is a property of certain membranes, such as the plasma membrane in biological systems, that only allow certain types of substances to pass through. Generally, these membranes are impermeable to large and polar molecules like ions, proteins, and polysaccharides, while being permeable to non-polar or hydrophobic molecules like lipids and to small molecules like oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, and nitric oxide. The permeability depends on factors such as solubility, charge, or chemistry, as well as solute size. Water molecules, for example, can travel through the plasma membrane, tonoplast membrane (vacuole), or protoplast by diffusing across the phospholipid bilayer via aquaporins, which are small transmembrane proteins.
So how do cells maintain different concentrations of proteins and molecules despite the pressures on them to be homogenous?

Cells maintain different concentrations of proteins and molecules inside and outside of them through the process of osmosis and the semi-permeable nature of their cell membranes. The cell membrane allows for the passage of certain molecules, such as small, uncharged ones, while restricting the movement of others, like large and polar molecules. This selective permeability helps to maintain the internal environment of the cell, known as homeostasis. Additionally, cells can actively transport certain molecules against their concentration gradient, using energy in the form of ATP, to further maintain these concentration differences.

evidence.text:
Kobe Bryant
Bryant was born in Philadelphia , as the youngest of three children and the only son of former NBA player Joe Bryant and Pamela Cox Bryant . He is also the maternal nephew of basketball player John `` Chubby '' Cox . His parents named him after the famous beef of Kobe , Japan , which they saw on a restaurant menu . His middle name , Bean , is derived from his father 's nickname `` Jellybean '' . Bryant was raised Roman Catholic . When Bryant was six , his father left the NBA and moved his family to Rieti in Italy to continue playing professional basketball . Bryant became accustomed to his new lifestyle and learned to speak fluent Italian . During summers , he would come back to the United States to play in a basketball summer league .

Kobe Bryant
Kobe Bean Bryant ( born August 23 , 1978 ) is an American retired professional basketball player and businessman . He played his entire 20 - year career with the Los Angeles Lakers of the National Basketball Association ( NBA ) . He entered the NBA directly from high school and won five NBA championships with the Lakers . Bryant is an 18 - time All - Star , 15 - time member of the All - NBA Team , and 12 - time member of the All - Defensive team . He led the NBA in scoring during two seasons , and ranks third on the league 's all - time regular season scoring and fourth on the all - time postseason scoring list . He holds the NBA record for the most seasons playing with one franchise for an entire career .

Michael Jordan
Jordan was born in Brooklyn , New York , to Deloris ( née Peoples ) , who worked in banking , and James R. Jordan Sr. , an equipment supervisor . His family moved to Wilmington , North Carolina , when he was a toddler .
